title: XnnTransfer project blueprint
mission: Deliver direct, explicit, secure, cross-platform file transfer between peers on the same LAN without weakening hostile-input, persistence, or delivery guarantees.

goals.title: Direct LAN file transfer
goals.statement: Users can discover, authenticate, and transfer files directly on a LAN across supported desktop platforms.

goals.title: Auditable engineering integrity
goals.statement: Every product increment is derived from one project model and accepted from immutable exact-candidate evidence.

outcomes.title: Versioned bounded protocol contract
outcomes.statement: Version 1 framing, negotiation, transcript order, and limits are specified and validated against hostile vectors.

criteria.statement: The versioned protocol specification and vectors define bounded parsing, negotiation, and transcript failure behavior.
negative_definitions: Parser acceptance without protocol ordering does not qualify.
An unbounded field or collection does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: Existing historical evidence must be requalified against the Blueprint before this outcome is current.

outcomes.title: Asynchronous versioned C ABI
outcomes.statement: Flutter observes native operations only through a versioned asynchronous C ABI with explicit ownership and bounded event delivery.

criteria.statement: The frozen caller remains ABI compatible and native shutdown prevents callbacks after the shutdown barrier.
negative_definitions: Passing only a same-version caller does not qualify.
Borrowed native memory crossing the ABI does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: Existing historical evidence must be requalified against the Blueprint before this outcome is current.

outcomes.title: Cross-platform native library packaging
outcomes.statement: Linux, macOS, and Windows desktop bundles load the project native library through the supported adapter.

criteria.statement: Each supported desktop platform builds, bundles, loads, and smoke-tests the canonical native library.
negative_definitions: Building without loading the bundled library does not qualify.
Using a system dependency fallback does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: Packaging is implemented but requires Blueprint qualification evidence.

outcomes.title: LAN peer discovery
outcomes.statement: Peers are discovered and expired across interface changes without treating reachability as identity.

criteria.statement: Discovery handles expiry and interface changes while exposing only untrusted peer candidates.
negative_definitions: Treating an announcement as authenticated identity does not qualify.
Retaining a peer beyond bounded expiry does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: The concrete implementation requires requalification and cross-platform interface evidence.

outcomes.title: Authenticated peer pairing
outcomes.statement: Users explicitly pair peers and bind protected identity to the authenticated TLS transport.

criteria.statement: Pairing proves key possession, requires explicit user confirmation, and stores identity only in qualified protected storage.
negative_definitions: Unauthenticated discovery data authorizing a session does not qualify.
A plaintext or silent storage fallback does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: The identity, TLS, and pairing implementation requires Blueprint security requalification.

outcomes.title: Authenticated one-file transfer
outcomes.statement: One explicitly accepted file is transferred over an authenticated session, hash verified, and atomically committed.

criteria.statement: An explicitly accepted one-file transfer commits exact verified bytes and leaves no destination file on failure or cancellation.
negative_definitions: Receiving bytes before authentication and acceptance does not qualify.
Renaming unverified temporary content does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: The implemented vertical slice requires end-to-end Blueprint qualification.

outcomes.title: Flutter transfer flow
outcomes.statement: Flutter presents peer selection, pairing, send, receive, progress, and terminal outcomes through application abstractions.

criteria.statement: The desktop UI exposes the complete vertical-slice state machine without presentation code calling FFI directly.
negative_definitions: A fake-only gateway presented as native integration does not qualify.
A widget importing dart:ffi does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: The existing Flutter flow requires end-to-end native and platform qualification.

outcomes.title: Deterministic cancellation
outcomes.statement: Cancellation reaches a terminal state, stops observable work, and deterministically removes temporary state.

criteria.statement: Cancellation is idempotent, bounded, and leaves neither callbacks nor temporary destination state after its barrier.
negative_definitions: A best-effort request without a terminal barrier does not qualify.
Leaving a resumable record without policy authorization does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: Existing cancellation behavior requires concurrency and cleanup requalification.

outcomes.title: Portable Windows destination paths
outcomes.statement: Shared path validation rejects Windows reserved aliases and trailing ASCII dot or space components before filesystem access.

criteria.statement: The shared path validator rejects ASCII-case variants of CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1 through COM9, and LPT1 through LPT9 with or without extensions, plus every component ending in an ASCII dot or space.
negative_definitions: Rejecting only exact uppercase aliases does not qualify.
Rejecting an alias without rejecting the same alias with an extension does not qualify.
Relying on a Windows filesystem error after validation does not qualify.
Rejecting ordinary interior dots or spaces does not qualify.
A skipped platform Gate does not qualify.

outcomes.title: Multi-file manifests and directories
outcomes.statement: Bounded manifests preserve directory structure and commit a validated multi-file transfer consistently.

criteria.statement: A bounded multi-file manifest is validated as one transfer and cannot escape the selected destination.
negative_definitions: Unbounded file count or aggregate size does not qualify.
Partially committed destination trees do not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: No approved V2 delivery Plan currently owns this outcome.

outcomes.title: Chunk scheduling and backpressure
outcomes.statement: Chunk scheduling bounds memory and I/O while reporting meaningful progress and rate.

criteria.statement: Backpressure keeps queued bytes and concurrent filesystem work within declared budgets.
negative_definitions: Unbounded buffering does not qualify.
A rate calculated from uncommitted bytes does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: No approved V2 delivery Plan currently owns this outcome.

outcomes.title: Transfer resume
outcomes.statement: A transfer resumes after reconnect or restart from authenticated, versioned, bounded persisted state.

criteria.statement: Resume state is versioned, authenticated, bounded, and cannot commit bytes that were not revalidated.
negative_definitions: Trusting stale peer state without authentication does not qualify.
Persisting an undocumented format does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: ADR 0010 remains proposed and no approved V2 delivery Plan owns this outcome.

outcomes.title: Destination collision policy
outcomes.statement: Destination selection applies an explicit collision policy without overwriting unrelated content.

criteria.statement: Every destination collision resolves through explicit policy and remains inside the validated destination.
negative_definitions: Implicit overwrite does not qualify.
A time-of-check/time-of-use destination escape does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: The storage implementation requires policy-level requalification.

outcomes.title: Adverse platform behavior
outcomes.statement: Transfers behave deterministically under low space, large files, sleep or wake, and network changes.

criteria.statement: Supported platforms expose deterministic terminal or resumable outcomes for low-space, large-file, sleep, wake, and network-change scenarios.
negative_definitions: A platform skip does not qualify.
Silent data loss or an unbounded hang does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: No approved V2 delivery Plan currently owns the adverse-platform matrix.

outcomes.title: Extended fuzz coverage
outcomes.statement: Session, manifest, storage, transfer, C ABI, and protocol hostile-input surfaces have maintained fuzz targets and corpora.

criteria.statement: Every hostile-input parser and transfer boundary has a sanitizer-backed fuzz target with retained regression corpus.
negative_definitions: Only C ABI and protocol smoke fuzzing does not qualify.
A fuzz target that skips unavailable code does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: Current fuzzing covers only a subset of the required surfaces.

outcomes.title: Cross-platform interoperability
outcomes.statement: Every supported sender and receiver platform pair interoperates over the same versioned contracts.

criteria.statement: The full Linux, macOS, and Windows sender-receiver matrix passes exact-byte and authenticated-session scenarios.
negative_definitions: Per-platform self-tests alone do not qualify.
A partial matrix presented as complete does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: No approved V2 delivery Plan currently owns the interoperability matrix.

outcomes.title: Signed application packaging
outcomes.statement: Release artifacts are signed, reproducibly associated with accepted source, and governed by an update policy.

criteria.statement: Each release artifact is signed and traceable to the exact accepted source and update policy.
negative_definitions: Unsigned development bundles do not qualify.
A signature without source provenance does not qualify.

outcomes.title: Telemetry and privacy policy
outcomes.statement: Any diagnostics or telemetry are bounded by an explicit privacy policy and default behavior.

criteria.statement: Collected diagnostics, retention, consent, and default-off behavior are explicitly specified and verified.
negative_definitions: Undocumented telemetry does not qualify.
Collecting peer identity or file metadata by default does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: No telemetry or privacy Delivery Plan exists.

outcomes.title: Performance and resource budgets
outcomes.statement: Transfer throughput, memory, CPU, file-descriptor, and cancellation latency budgets are measured and enforced.

criteria.statement: Representative transfer workloads enforce approved throughput and resource budgets on supported platforms.
negative_definitions: An informational lifecycle microbenchmark does not qualify.
A budget without a blocking Gate does not qualify.

outcomes.deferred_reason: Current benchmarks are informational and no approved blocking budget exists.

outcomes.title: Harness V2 control plane
outcomes.statement: Static contracts, append-only runtime state, immutable submissions, exact-candidate CI, and CAS publication form the delivery control plane.

criteria.statement: Only immutable submission-equivalent candidates with complete exact-candidate evidence can advance the protected branch.
negative_definitions: A local-only result does not qualify.
A second unverified payload after review does not qualify.

outcomes.title: Harness V2 governed pilot
outcomes.statement: A real low-risk task traverses the complete Harness V2 lifecycle without manual runtime edits.

criteria.statement: The documentation pilot moves from ready through claim, submission, queue, hosted evidence, publication, and done without manual runtime-state edits.
negative_definitions: A local-only Gate result does not qualify.
A candidate with more than one hosted workflow run does not qualify.
A manually edited state ref does not qualify.

outcomes.title: Harness V2 pilot evidence report
outcomes.statement: The pilot evidence, latency, closure, and residual limits are recorded without inventing unmeasured SLOs.

criteria.statement: The implementation plan, migration status, worklog, and acceptance checklist identify both exact candidate runs, publication evidence, closure evidence, observed latency, and residual SLO limits.
negative_definitions: Chat-only evidence does not qualify.
Marking an unmeasured P95 or concurrency target as passing does not qualify.
Leaving the pilot status as pending does not qualify.
A local-only Gate result does not qualify.

outcomes.title: Transient branch reclamation
outcomes.statement: Transient work and queue refs are reclaimed only after durable evidence while authoritative refs remain immutable.

criteria.statement: Submission and payload-free acceptance closure remove the exact local work branch after its worktree is released and durable lifecycle evidence exists.
negative_definitions: Deleting a work branch before submission or closure evidence is durable does not qualify.
Deleting a branch whose SHA changed after review does not qualify.
Leaving a completed task work branch indefinitely does not qualify.

criteria.statement: Successful publication, publication recovery, queue rejection after archival, and bootstrap publication delete the exact remote and local queue ref with compare-and-swap semantics.
negative_definitions: Deleting a queued candidate before durable acceptance or archive evidence exists does not qualify.
Deleting a queue ref that moved to another SHA does not qualify.
Deleting an archive ref after queue cleanup does not qualify.
Treating a failed cleanup as successful does not qualify.

criteria.statement: An idempotent branch GC command reports and reclaims only transient refs whose durable state, acceptance, bootstrap attestation, or archive evidence proves eligibility.
negative_definitions: GC deleting approve, state, submit, attest, archive, main, or harness refs does not qualify.
GC deleting an active or queued task candidate does not qualify.
GC relying on branch age or name without evidence does not qualify.
GC defaulting to destructive execution does not qualify.

outcomes.title: Global project semantic baseline
outcomes.statement: One Blueprint governs project outcomes, Plan composition, code asset disposition, and deterministic documentation projections.

criteria.statement: Every product outcome, dependency, invariant, milestone, and implementation module belongs to one acyclic globally validated Blueprint graph.
negative_definitions: A collection of unrelated Delivery Plans does not qualify as a project graph.
A handwritten roadmap that duplicates machine-readable facts does not qualify.
An orphan capability, outcome, invariant, module, or milestone does not qualify.
A cycle hidden across files or node types does not qualify.

criteria.statement: Every active Delivery Plan is an executable transition over revision-bound Blueprint outcomes, and the approved Plan catalogue composes without duplicate writers, unsatisfied preconditions, invariant gaps, or undeclared effects.
negative_definitions: Treating a Delivery Plan as an independent source of product truth does not qualify.
Binding every Plan to one whole-Blueprint digest does not qualify.
Two Plans writing the same outcome transition do not qualify.
A Plan that weakens a Blueprint criterion or invariant does not qualify.
A stale Plan whose referenced node revision changed does not qualify.

criteria.statement: Every production asset is mapped to a Blueprint module and classified as preserve, requalify, replace, or remove with evidence, rationale, and ordered follow-up outcomes.
negative_definitions: Deleting all product code without asset-level evidence does not qualify.
Automatically treating legacy acceptance as current Blueprint qualification does not qualify.
Keeping a duplicate provider or stale placeholder declaration does not qualify.
Classifying an asset without a module, evidence reference, or rationale does not qualify.

criteria.statement: Roadmap, capability, module, and re-baseline reports are deterministic projections of the Blueprint while explanatory documents and ADRs remain hand-authored.
negative_definitions: A generated document that can drift from its source does not qualify.
Runtime task state committed into the generated roadmap does not qualify.
Replacing ADR rationale with generated JSON does not qualify.
Maintaining a second handwritten milestone or module truth does not qualify.
